title: Next.js audit-trail dashboard
context: This is the visual proof for judges — the audit trail requirement from the track brief needs to be seen, not just logged to a terminal.
objective: Build a dashboard page listing checkout sessions with status, and a detail view showing the full audit trail for a session including any rejection reasons.
scope_in: List view: session id, status, total, timestamp
Detail view: full AuditEntry history for one session, reasons clearly visible for any rejected entries
Reads live from Firestore, no mock data in the final version
scope_out: No auth/login for this dashboard — internal demo tool only
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard loads and lists real sessions created by the buyer_agent_sim runs
Clicking into a session shows its full audit history in chronological order
A rejected session's reason string is clearly visible, not truncated or hidden
